verdict.rationale: Token2 publishes fido2-manage, an official open-source libfido2-based utility in its own GitHub org. It provides command-line tools for passkey, PIN, biometric and SSH-key management, plus JSON/CSV export that suits scripted or agent-driven use. Missing for 10: a documented command reference or flag syntax in the evidence, AI- or agent-specific guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: providing command-line tools and an optional graphical interface for advanced key management operations
